shankara.author: Śaṅkara
shankara.title: Kena Upanishad with Śaṅkara’s Commentary, translated by S. Sitarama Sastri (1905)
shankara.note: Public-domain English translation. Summaries below are newly written; short quotations are identified separately. Some source pages discuss several consecutive mantras together.

sarvananda.author: Swami Sarvananda
sarvananda.title: Kena Upanishad, Sanskrit–English PDF
sarvananda.note: The title page spells the author’s name Swami Sharvananda; the linked filename uses Sarvanand. PDF references use file-page numbers, including front matter. Summaries were checked against the audited local copy.

gambhirananda.author: Swami Gambhirananda, translator of Śaṅkara
gambhirananda.title: Śaṅkara’s bhāṣya in English, presented alongside A. K. Aruna’s analysis at UpasanaYoga
gambhirananda.note: The labelled bhāṣya translation is distinguished from the site’s separate translation and grammatical analysis by A. K. Aruna. This is another English presentation of Śaṅkara, not a different author’s bhāṣya.

chinmayananda1.author: Swami Chinmayananda
chinmayananda1.title: Kenopanishad Yajna Prasad, vol. 4, p. 130; excerpt reproduced in Chinmaya Archives, Jnana Yajna 1
chinmayananda1.note: The excerpt discusses the power behind the senses. Its placement beside 1.2 is an editorial thematic match; the archive excerpt does not supply a mantra number.

chinmayananda6.author: Swami Chinmayananda
chinmayananda6.title: Kenopanishad teaching excerpt, Chinmaya Archives, Jnana Yajna 6
chinmayananda6.note: A short quotation on expressing the Infinite. Its connection to 1.3 is thematic; it is not represented as a numbered verse commentary.

vivekananda.author: Swami Vivekananda
vivekananda.title: Soul, Nature and God, Complete Works, volume 2
vivekananda.note: A related lecture, not a Kena bhāṣya. The passage on hearing and attention is placed beside 1.2 as a clearly labelled parallel.

radhakrishnan.author: S. Radhakrishnan
radhakrishnan.title: The Principal Upaniṣads, Kena, section II, notes on 2.3–2.5 (printed pp. 585–587)
radhakrishnan.note: Brief paraphrases of the author’s notes, checked in the digitized text. No OCR Sanskrit or long modern translation is reproduced.
